compiled_state.title: Add end-to-end integration test exercising all three touchpoints against the same artifact in sequence
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3 (cross-touchpoint slice): verifies the cross-touchpoint invariant that cycles[] entries accumulate across all touchpoints on a single artifact
- dd-6 (cross-touchpoint slice): verifies single-ticket-comment across touchpoints

## Testing Mode
RED

## Files to Modify
- tests/scripts/test-review-cycles-end-to-end.sh (Create)

## Implementation Notes
Drive a single review artifact through all 3 touchpoints in sequence:
1. Preplanning Phase E append (n=1)
2. Implementation-plan Step 2 append (n=2) 
3. Sprint verifier-fail append (n=3)

Assert:
- Final cycles[] has exactly 3 entries with monotonically increasing n values (1, 2, 3)
- Exactly one ticket comment exists referencing the artifact path (dedupe key from task-1 schema contract)
- Artifact remains valid JSON throughout
- All 3 entries have correct 5-field schema

## Acceptance Criteria
1. tests/scripts/test-review-cycles-end-to-end.sh exists and is executable
2. Test drives all 3 touchpoints sequentially against single artifact
3. Test asserts final cycles[] length == 3 with n=1, n=2, n=3
4. Test asserts single ticket comment referencing artifact path
5. Test asserts artifact is valid JSON at each intermediate step
6. Run: bash tests/scripts/test-review-cycles-end-to-end.sh → PASS
